verdict.rationale: monday.com's own integration directory claims 2-way sync with any platform, a real-time cross-platform view, and 850+ integrations to centralize work. That plausibly lets tasks from other tools land in monday boards. However, no evidence names other project management tools (e.g. Jira, Asana, Trello) as sync sources, or shows a per-user 'my assigned tasks' view across them. Missing for 10: documented sync of tasks from specific PM tools, an aggregated assigned-to-me view across sources, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can see my assigned tasks from multiple project management tools in one unified view

citations.quote: Enable 2-way sync between monday products and any platform you work with
Gain a real-time, cross-platform view that keeps data aligned and teams empowered
Discover 850+ integrations and apps to centralize work
